items.title: Storey / escape height
items.detail: About 2 storeys — confirm a clear final exit route and whether the stair needs protection for this HMO size.

items.title: Protected escape route
items.detail: Confirm hallway/stair enclosure, final exits, and any dead-end conditions on site.

items.title: Fire doors (bedrooms / kitchen)
items.detail: With 3 letting rooms, FD30-grade doors to bedrooms and the shared kitchen are commonly expected.

items.title: Detection & alarm
items.detail: LD1 interlinked detection is the typical standard at 4 bedrooms including the staff sleep-in (up to 4).

items.title: Kitchen fire separation
items.detail: Shared kitchens are a primary fire risk — check door closers, heat detection, and separation from the escape route.

items.title: Care / supported living fire plan
items.detail: Supported living often needs a person-centred evacuation strategy and may trigger enhanced detection or sprinkler expectations — confirm with the care model and fire officer.
